pages.title: Rewind Ward
pages.text: A trace of what the Paradox Echo carries, prepared so the body is ready for it. Use it on yourself: held safe from Rewind for three in-game days. Renew it while more than half of that is left and the imprint overloads instead. Made on the Antibody Bench.
Made in $(item)Antibody Bench$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Germinal Centre chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Immunisation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Lasting Rewind Ward.
